actions.body:
Dear Keira,

Thank you for sending the carton view for order VEL-010-26.

We're sorry, but we can't confirm from a picture of the outside of the box that the scanner inside is the right one, or that it is undamaged and working. The image shows a closed carton marked with seal FS-010, which matches the seal recorded when your order was packed. We have noted this as a packaging observation. However, Fernoptic only judges which item was sent and what condition it is in from evidence of the item itself.

When you open the parcel, please check:
- that the item is a Fernoptic Scanlet S4 (the model on your order)
- whether you can see any damage to the item
- whether it switches on and works as expected

If anything is wrong, please send photos of the item itself and a short description of the problem. You can reply to this email or contact Fernoptic at support@fernoptic.example. Fernoptic will then assess it and decide on any next step.

If everything is as expected, no further action is needed.

This is not a confirmation of the item's condition or of any outcome.

Kind regards,
Vellora escalation desk
